report.assessment: The evidence supports comparing all scoped cultivation runs reproducibly: peak-VCD, endpoint-viability and feed profiles were compared with certified arithmetic over source-verified cells, and every screening unit and priority candidate received an explicit disposition. Most paired runs agree within a few percent on peak viable cell density. Three findings warrant human attention. First, EXP011/R02 is a materially divergent run: a corroborated culture viability collapse after its collapse-start sample (peak VCD far below its pair per the linked percent-change metric, terminal viability zero with total cell density persisting, and inline permittivity declining in parallel), combined with a unique early feed-record halt and a terminal CO2-sparging pattern unlike any other scoped run; the proximate cause is not determinable from the numeric-only scoped package. Second, the EXP001 paired runs diverged in opposite directions (the R01 run peaked much higher but ended near-zero viability, while the R02 run peaked lower but remained largely viable at the end; magnitudes carried by linked metrics). Third, several permittivity-derived series are unusable for cross-run comparison because the multifrequency scan appears not to have been acquired for the R02 runs of EXP001 through EXP003, which constrains comparability metrics. Remaining screening anomalies resolved into benign artifacts (single-interval record reordering, constant intended setpoints, end-of-run gas shutdowns mirrored in paired runs, max-vs-last descriptive artifacts) or expected batch signatures. No regulated action is proposed; all dispositions are advisory pending human review. Severity MEDIUM is proposed advisively because one corroborated culture collapse with an unexplained feed halt is action-relevant, while the remaining signals are artifacts or expected states; final severity follows the configured routing policy.

report.cross_scope_synthesis: Across the 12 experiments (24 paired cultivation runs), within-experiment peak-VCD reproducibility is good for 8 of 12 experiments (R02 vs R01 within -11.25%..+7.30%), confirming that most paired runs are comparable. Three patterns cut across sources. (1) Real paired-run divergence: EXP001 (-39.36% peak VCD; opposite endpoint-viability asymmetry +64.25 pp) and EXP011 (-69.17% peak VCD; endpoint viability 0.0% vs 9.47%) are materially divergent pairs; EXP003 shows a +73.93 pp endpoint-viability asymmetry despite close peaks. EXP011/R02 is corroborated as a real collapse by three independent signals (offline VCD to zero, inline permittivity decline, terminal TCD persistence with zero viability), and it uniquely combines an early feed-record halt (t=67.14 h) with a terminal gas pattern unlike every other run. (2) Package-wide acquisition/export artifacts, not process events: backwards_source_time flags everywhere resolve to single -0.0083 h (30 s) record-ordering steps with no clock reset (EXP001, EXP003, EXP004, EXP007, EXP009/R02, EXP012); the multifrequency permittivity scan appears not acquired for EXP001-EXP003 R02 runs (entire derived series zero while raw channels are normal); EXP008/R01's high Cole-fit RMSE is 16 isolated early spikes; EXP007/R01's reflection endpoint is a max-vs-last artifact. (3) Expected operating signatures: constant 0 g feed in all ten batch runs (EXP005-EXP009), constant 100 rpm agitation mirrored in paired runs (EXP008/EXP009), and end-of-run gas-mixing shutdowns mirrored in paired runs (EXP004, EXP010). Limits: the scoped package contains only numeric sensor/assay logs - no recipes, controller records, calibration records, narrative or deviation records - so intended-state confirmations, root-cause discrimination for EXP011/R02, and assay-replicate-level checks remain open; reported Mean/SEM columns are source summaries; log ends prove only that logs end. Fed-batch vs batch labels come from filenames; mean peak VCD (batch 9,418,704 vs fed-batch 9,006,667 cells/mL) is similar, so mode alone does not explain peaks.
